actual_campaign.scope: Authorized actual Qwen phases only; all calibration, BASIC, tactics and diagnostics retained. Development assistant inference and offline test doubles are outside runtime-model price accounting. Standard-price usage comparison, not invoice.

explicit_boundary_stop.reason: Confirmed host false-negative: aggregate source span supported by gapless adjacent/overlapping actually supplied same-source/revision ranges was rejected because containment only accepted one passage. Root instructed finish current episode, stop next job, preserve history, then new common minimal guard freeze ABC36 plus numbered9.
explicit_boundary_stop.orchestration_action: SIGSTOP parent only while current worker continued; after worker exited and durable record+usage confirmed, SIGKILL stopped orchestrator parent only. Current worker stdout need not appear in orchestration.log; durable runs.jsonl/trace and ledger are canonical.

actual_campaign.elapsed_scope: All durations use actual monotonic timestamps. Trial sum includes Rust/process startup observation and source preparation within each trial. Phase record windows include between-trial setup. Campaign window additionally includes implementation/review/interphase gaps, so it is not model execution time. Provider call wall sum double-counts parallel calls; union/overlap are reported separately.

dp05_all_three_observed_goal_intersectio.scope: Post hoc same-goal×repetition observed intersection only; does not replace fixed21 denominators or prove whole-population superiority.

content_manual_and_equivalence: Independent bounded literal/equivalence and author source reviews remain separate; host completion does not establish all requested facts or every first callback meaning.
limits: Authored finite four-case inputs repeated three times; descriptive observations only
First callback proxy is not a fully semantically verified correct-content endpoint
Missing/failed endpoints are retained; observed-only means are conditional and do not establish unconditional winners
DP05 receiver HTTP spans are excluded only in the explicit bounded shim profile; full wall is adjacent
RSS Python+Rust same-sample estimate only; initial is startup, logical bytes are not RSS; retained audit records are experimental overhead
Numbered-input diagnostic RAM is not comparable as architecture RAM: eager pretrial prior-record parsing already inflated initial Python RSS to about694MB; exact allocator attribution unprofiled
Original BASIC120 and all failures preserved; whole corrected DP0536 replaces the whole original DP05 population only for explicit effective120 presentation
